## Purpose

Fix Mistral streaming reasoning extraction when the prompt already contains a completed `[THINK]…[/THINK]` block (e.g. the always-on reasoning models' system-prompt example, a tool-result think chunk, or a prior assistant turn).

Related to #45891 / #46663 (generic serving-side prompt-tail fix). This PR is Mistral-specific and complementary: it also scopes the streaming skip path used by structured output, and handles tool-result/system/prior-turn boundaries and.

## Test Plan

`pytest tests/reasoning/test_mistral_reasoning_parser.py -v`

## Test Result

Passing.

Just so you know, for mistral reasoning_end is hardcoded to True in https://github.com/sfeng33/vllm/blob/482e5524fe12b2793ae3a9d861754ffd4cee10ca/vllm/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/serving.py#L347
So in the structured-output module, it bypassed calling is_reasoning_end in https://github.com/sfeng33/vllm/blob/main/vllm/v1/structured_output/__init__.py#L360

nodes.body: Can I assume for post v11 and reasoning parser is set, the lark grammar would enforce the model to always generate thinking block? If so, I think a one liner fix here to return False would fix the bug. Since the bug is only for streaming case where prompt contains [THINK]…[/THINK], by is_reasoning_end returning false, this prompt checking is essentially skipped.

+def test_is_reasoning_end_ignores_prompt_example_think_block(
+    mistral_tokenizer: MistralTokenizer,
+    mistral_parser: ReasoningParser,
+):
+    begin_think = mistral_tokenizer.instruct.BEGIN_THINK
+    end_think = mistral_tokenizer.instruct.END_THINK

+    end_inst = mistral_tokenizer.tokenizer.get_special_token(SpecialTokens.end_inst)
+
+    prompt = (
+        [begin_system]
+        + _encode(mistral_tokenizer, "You are a helpful assistant. For example:")
+        + [begin_think]
+        + _encode(mistral_tokenizer, "example reasoning")
+        + [end_think]
+        + _encode(mistral_tokenizer, "done")
+        + [end_system]
+        + [begin_inst]
+        + _encode(mistral_tokenizer, "What is the capital of France?")
+        + [end_inst]
+    )
+
+    assert mistral_parser.is_reasoning_end(prompt) is False
+
+
+def test_is_reasoning_end_ignores_tool_result_think_block(

+    end_tool_results = mistral_tokenizer.tokenizer.get_special_token(
+        SpecialTokens.end_tool_results
+    )
+
+    input_ids = (
+        [begin_inst]
+        + _encode(mistral_tokenizer, "call a tool")
+        + [end_inst]
+        + [begin_tool_results]
+        + [begin_think]
+        + _encode(mistral_tokenizer, "tool-side reasoning")
+        + [end_think]
+        + _encode(mistral_tokenizer, "tool output")

+
